title: 17 organizations using AI to accelerate scientific breakthroughs
key_facts: Google.org is awarding $36 million to 17 organizations through its Impact Challenge: AI for Science.
Applications came from 30 countries in climate, health and foundational science.
Recipients can join a six-month Google.org Accelerator with engineering support, mentorship and Google infrastructure.
Areas named include fusion energy, disease treatment and environmental resilience.
Smallholder farmers are among the groups the funded work aims to help.
quote_evidence: Google.org is awarding $36 million to 17 organizations using artificial intelligence to solve critical challenges in climate, health, and foundational science.
why_it_matters_hint: A large corporate-philanthropy award for AI-driven science, in Google's own words.
notes: Google's own announcement; the post is promotional in tone and the list of recipients was not fully read.
